title: Chapter 6797: Utter Nonsense

Chapter 6797: Utter Nonsense

Chapter 6797: Utter Nonsense

Only a few remembered his name as Li Baye, Sheng Shengxian was one of them.

Numerous thoughts flashed in Sheng Shengxian’s mind as he waved his hands, summoning two immortal chairs.

“Please have a seat.” He invited and waited for Li Qiye to sit before doing the same.

“You must be a master, Sir.” He said.

“Just a passerby.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I see, a visitor to Heavenrealm.” Sheng Shengxian pondered.

“Want to know my background?” Li Qiye asked directly.

As an apex primordial immortal, he could see time and observe anyone’s identity. However, some were exceptions.

Li Baye and this Li Qiye were part of the list. Masters at their level had taboos and forbidden secrets.

“Of course not, I’m just curious.” He bowed.

“You had an unyielding dao before becoming a primordial immortal. Now, you have transformed.” Li Qiye said.

“You recognize me?” He found it strange.

“I’ve heard of you.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I apologize for not knowing you.” He couldn’t recall Li Qiye.

After all, even if he had met Li Qiye, he couldn’t connect the two entities since Li Qiye was the crow back then.

Moreover, it would be billions of years in the past. Now, he was different from his youthful self.

“Sir, may I ask what guidance you bring during this visit?” He asked.

“Nothing, I’m just taking them with me.” Li Qiye smiled.

He glanced at the duo. The woman embracing the saber opened her mouth but ended up saying nothing, only shooting a glance at Li Qiye.

“I will go with the young noble.” The middle-aged man was direct.

“Sir, I’m afraid there’s a misunderstanding. Our alliance does not force anyone to do anything. This young friend has a peerless talent for the sword dao, he requires a proper sword domain to break the limit and become a sword immortal...”

“No need for advice. When it comes to cultivation, I have my method to teach my people.” Li Qiye waved.

“Sir, we mustered all of our understanding of the sword dao to craft the best sword domain for him.” He shook his head.

Just seeing Sheng Shengxian was the fortune of three lifetimes, let alone being guided by him. In this scenario, the middle-aged man had his support along with numerous other immortals, crafting a special domain to stimulate his sword dao.

An overlord would want nothing more than to have this privilege. Becoming an immortal was only a matter of time. However, the man chose to go with Li Qiye.

“Utter nonsense. This is madness, not the sword dao.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

Sheng Shengxian’s expression soured since he had spent considerable effort in grooming the genius. In all of Heavenrealm, who else could have done a better job? Moreover, those stronger than him were either missing or living reclusively.

“Sir, this domain can reach the pinnacle of the sword dao...” He refused to accept the criticism that was nothing short of a slap to the face.

“Enough, don’t peddle your misguided nonsense before me. I will teach him.” Li Qiye said.

“So you must bring him away?” He took a deep breath.

“You wish to stop me? You alone can’t, gather your whole alliance so I can finish this right away. Get Genesis here, I’ll teach him a lesson about the dao as well.” Li Qiye said.

Anyone would be shocked to hear this. He showed no consideration for Heaven Assault Alliance.

No other faction stood a chance outside of Guardian Alliance. Heaven Assault had numerous immortals and five primordial immortals, not to mention the mysterious Genesis.

“Sir, these are menacing words.” He said.

“Only the weak would make threats. I am merely speaking the truth.” Li Qiye smiled.

Sheng Shengxian changed his attitude and stared straight at Li Qiye’s eyes.
